key_insight: Repeated text defeats content-based copying, but a compact two-layer transformer can copy and stop correctly by encoding positions as modular distances from delimiter anchors.
engineering_relevance: Position-aware retrieval offers a route to more reliable exact copying and termination when repeated content makes local token matches ambiguous.
method: Apply RoPE-style rotations to attention values and outputs using small prime periods.
Combine modular distances via the Chinese Remainder Theorem to retrieve the next token or end marker.
Prove a copying impossibility result under sequential finite-precision softmax accumulation for positional biases that eventually become constant.
evidence_signal: In synthetic copying experiments, baselines failed on long repeated strings even within training lengths, while trained VO models generalized beyond training with near-perfect accuracy up to approximately 5005 tokens, the selected primes' period product.
watch_item: The guarantee is bounded by a chosen design horizon, and synthetic copying results do not establish reliability in general-purpose LLM deployments.
paper_title: Copying Under Repetition: From Prefix Matching to Position Hashing
